name: Mont Fébé
description: Hilltop view offering panoramic vistas over the City of Seven Hills, serene monastery gardens, and fresh air.

name: Musée National
description: Historical landmark displaying Cameroon's royal artifacts, traditional masks, musical instruments, and independence history.

name: Mefou National Park
description: Protected primate sanctuary on the outskirts of Yaoundé, home to rescued gorillas, chimpanzees, and baboons in dense rainforest.
